    | text      = We'll get there.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:59.206
    | text      = All right?

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}
